name: Yamabiko Outdoor Supply
description: Yamabiko Outdoor Supply — a WooCommerce store theme for an independent outdoor and camping gear shop, built as a spec catalogue. A full-bleed documentary cover with a white info bar, a fixed bottom-left dash index, a dark capsule field-pick chip, an inset photo band under a dark veil with three underlined shelf links, asymmetric masonry product tiles and full-width spec tables. Bitter for headings, Karla for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.

fonts.role: headings, product names, numerals (variable 300-600, Latin subset)
body, labels, navigation, prices (variable 200-800, Latin subset)

summary.en: An outdoor gear spec catalogue: full-bleed cover, inset veil band, dash index and a field-pick chip.
